patthana15.6:1.1: hetuṃ savitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana15.6:2.1: hetuṃ avitakka vicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi. hetuṃ
patthana15.6:3.1: avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na avitakka avicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. tīṇi.
